  base.base_revenue,
  curr.curr_revenue,
  CASE WHEN base.base_revenue IS NULL OR base.base_revenue = 0 THEN NULL

FROM (
  SELECT SUM("total") AS base_revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'

  SELECT SUM("total") AS curr_revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
) AS curr;
